newsitem.title: USA: Wet Seal stake cut by Zweig-DiMenna.
newsitem.headline: Wet Seal stake cut by Zweig-DiMenna.

text.p: A group led by Zweig-DiMenna Associates LLC said Wednesday it reduced its stake in Wet Seal Inc to 610,400 Class A common shares or 5.7 percent from 7.1 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 142,500 Class A common between January 27 and February 3 at prices ranging from 17.50 to $21.5288 per share.
Wet Seal, based in Irvine, Calif., is a specialty retailer of moderately priced fashionable casual apparel for women throughout the United States.
